company.name: Rubrik
company.shortDescription: Rubrik is a data security platform that delivers cyber resilience, cyber posture, and cyber recovery solutions.
company.description: Rubrik offers live data access for recovery and application development by fusing enterprise data management with web-scale IT and eliminating backup software. This marks the end of a decade-long innovation drought in backup and recovery, the backbone of IT. Within minutes, businesses can manage the explosion of data across private and public clouds.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based data security and management platform for protecting, monitoring, and recovering data across cloud, on-premises, and SaaS environments.
productsAndServices.name: Rubrik Security Cloud

productsAndServices.description: Data protection software that discovers, classifies, monitors, and protects sensitive data across enterprise environments to support recovery and compliance.
productsAndServices.name: Rubrik Data Protection

productsAndServices.description: A recovery solution for restoring business data and applications after ransomware or other cyber incidents using clean recovery points and automated recovery workflows.
productsAndServices.name: Rubrik Cyber Recovery

productsAndServices.description: An AI-agent security platform for inventorying agents, applying runtime controls, monitoring actions, and reversing harmful agent activity.
productsAndServices.name: Rubrik Agent Cloud

productsAndServices.description: Identity protection and recovery capabilities for monitoring identity providers, securing non-human identities, and restoring clean identity states after compromise.
productsAndServices.name: Rubrik Identity Recovery

productsAndServices.description: Backup and recovery protection for data stored in software-as-a-service applications, helping organizations preserve and restore SaaS data.
productsAndServices.name: Rubrik SaaS Data Protection
